_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see crates/modules/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Whether anyone can sign up (open) or new accounts need an administrator (restricted).
Failed sign-ins on one account, within the window, before sign-in is slowed down.
examples: slow down logins after 3 wrong passwords

settings.description: How long, in seconds, a network address is first blocked after too many failed sign-ins.
examples: block an IP for 5 minutes after failed logins

settings.description: Most chat sessions one account at this account level may keep.
How many agent runs one account at this account level may have going at the same time.
examples: base users can run 3 tasks at once
one run at a time for anonymous

settings.description: Display name of an account level.
examples: rename the Base level to Member

excluded./login_protection/account/*: Other login-protection timings; not offered in v1.
excluded./login_protection/address/*: Other login-protection timings; not offered in v1.
excluded./tier_order: Account level order; changed with the account levels themselves.
excluded./tiers/*/ability_permissions/**: Ability, tool and model grants act as ceilings (Q8); handled in a later step.
excluded./tiers/*/allowed_models/**: Ability, tool and model grants act as ceilings (Q8); handled in a later step.
excluded./tiers/*/entitlements/**: Ability, tool and model grants act as ceilings (Q8); handled in a later step.
excluded./tiers/*/model_policy/**: Ability, tool and model grants act as ceilings (Q8); handled in a later step.
excluded./tiers/*/tools/**: Ability, tool and model grants act as ceilings (Q8); handled in a later step.
